## Dressing for an Indian wedding

An Indian wedding has several functions, and each has its own mood. The golden rule for guests: look festive, but never compete with the bride – so skip heavy red bridal looks.

## What to wear to each function

| Function | What works | Colours |
|---|---|---|
| Haldi | Light cotton suit | Yellow, peach, pastels |
| Mehendi | Flowy cotton or Nyra cut suit | Green, pink, violet |
| Sangeet | Twirl-ready Anarkali | Jewel tones |
| Wedding | Georgette or taffeta Anarkali | Royal blue, sage, lavender |
| Reception | Embroidered suit with organza dupatta | Pastels, ivory |

## Attending a wedding abroad?

For weddings in the USA, UK or Canada, choose breathable fabrics for long indoor events and add a light shawl for cold evenings.

faq.q: Can I wear white or black to an Indian wedding?
faq.a: Off-white with colourful embroidery works for day functions. Avoid all-black and all-white for the main ceremony unless the family says it is fine.

faq.q: How early should I order for a wedding?
faq.a: Order at least 3 weeks before the event so there is time for stitching to your measurements and delivery.
